usedFor: Callbell holds your inbox contacts, and Google Docs gets a new entry through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Is Added” in Callbell, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Every new contact is written into a doc, giving you a plain running list outside the inbox.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s content, so choose the add option for a running list.
